notes.title: Demo version v0.0.17 update notes
notes.content:
v0.0.17
BUG FIXES

 Fixed localization issues in skill training displays.
 Fixed display problems in hover tooltips for Professions items.
 Fixed the Settings panel incorrectly showing a “Clear Data” in game.
 Fixed localization for the “Mastered” status on skill books.


IMPROVEMENTS & ADJUSTMENTS

 Improved wording for Intellect requirements on item tooltips.
 Added contextual tips across the Attributes panel.
 Increased the amount of random resources dropped after battles.
 Reduced the difficulty of the “Windgrove Ridge” quest.
 Improved the Quest Tracker UI—mouse wheel scrolling is now supported.
 Polished the UI effects for the top-left buttons on the main panel.
 Refined the “Quest Details” presentation in the Quest panel.
 Players can now equip up to three Principles simultaneously.
 All Origins now start with one Principle; the starting Principle is locked and cannot be replaced.
 For skill that require aptitude below a threshold, lower-aptitude characters now train them faster.

notes.title: Demo version v0.0.16 update notes
notes.content:
v0.0.16
BUG FIXES

 Fixed an issue where clicking too quickly on the battle results screen could cause an error.
 Fixed several quests that were missing quest descriptions.


IMPROVEMENTS & ADJUSTMENTS

 Reworked Ultimate: you can now manually trigger it when the qi bar is full.
 Improved localization layout for martial skill effect text.
 Lowered the difficulty of the “Disciples of the Zen Gate” event.
 Each battle victory now drops money.
 Chongwu Hall quest rewards are now a choice between a fixed reward and a random reward.
 Added two new Special Attacks: 
 ①Reversal — increases damage based on total damage taken outside the current turn; 
 ②Demonbane — deals extra damage when the user is under a negative status.
 Polished sect martial traits. The following sect traits are now enabled: 
 Shaolin — Demonbane; Wudang — Reversal; Starreach Pavilion — Backstab, Exploit; Divine Sword Manor — Absolute Hit; Wuwei Sect — Penetrate; Heavenly Sound Sect — Internal Injury, Severe.

notes.title: Demo version v0.0.15 update notes
notes.content:
v0.0.15
BUG FIXES

 Fixed an issue where attribute checks in “Music over the River” did not take effect.
 Fixed missing reward when refusing Ling Feng in that quest.
 Fixed missing localization in martial tome/tooltips.
 Fixed unlocalized options in sect quests for Sword Manor and Starreach Pavilion.
 Fixed locations such as the Inn and Shaolin Quiet Room sometimes becoming unclickable when overlapped by the quest tracker UI.
 Fixed missing localization for target item names in sect gathering quests.
 Attempted fix for BGM resuming after setting music volume to 0.


IMPROVEMENTS & ADJUSTMENTS

 Dialogue options now show the exact reward item next to the choice.
 Added multiple Qian-Kun Coffer items as new random loot sources.
 Converted some fixed quest rewards to Qian-Kun Coffer.
 Reduced the difficulty of duel enemies in sect quests.

notes.title: Demo version v0.0.14 update notes
notes.content:
v0.0.14
BUG FIXES

 Fixed an issue where obstacles at Thousand Cliff – Bottom became too hard to destroy after damage formula optimizations.
 Fixed a bug where Affinity quests showed no content after being accepted.
 Fixed a potential error when “He Gu” joins a battle.
 Fixed the NG+ branch selection issue for “Hepta-Kill Sword”.
 Fixed a display issue in no-enemy stages where tiles stayed invalid (dark/gray) and would not recover.


IMPROVEMENTS & ADJUSTMENTS

 Added the standard entry flow for Shaolin, Wudang, and Divine Sword Manor: start via the Sect Plaza by talking to the deacon.
 Added knockback collision damage: units now take damage when they are knocked back into obstacles or other units.
 Polished the Arts Duel UI.
 Adjusted positions of several map locations to prevent unclickable spots.
 Slightly increased nighttime brightness in scenes for better visibility.

notes.title: Demo Playable in English Now! 🎉
notes.content:
The demo now comes with an English version!


The text is currently AI-translated because of the script’s size, but the game is fully playable.

Please feel free to try it out—and if you notice anything odd, your feedback would help a lot. You’re also welcome to join the Discord and share your thoughts directly.



Discord：https://discord.gg/zMWhXWas5d

notes.title: Demo version v0.0.8 / v0.0.9 update notes

Fixed some items having incorrect usage restriction settings.

notes.title: Demo version v1.0.5 / v1.0.6 / v1.0.7 update notes
notes.content:
v1.0.7
Bug Fixes  

- Attempted to fix an issue that could cause a crash during certain battles.

Improvements and Adjustments  

- Increased the quantity of Four Treasures of the Study items sold in shops.  

- Added an annual refresh feature for shop inventory.  

- Added descriptions for items related to scholarly skills.  

- Reduced the price of Four Treasures of the Study items.  

- Added individual growth attributes for Xiao Hei.  

- Teammates no longer require a certain favorability level to learn, train from manuals, or switch martial arts.  

- Added automatic move selection at the start of turns.  

- Added difficulty selection for escort missions; in Easy and Normal modes, enemies will no longer prioritize attacking the carriage.  

- Added the ability to donate items to the sect storehouse in exchange for sect contribution points.


v1.0.6
Bug Fixes  

- Fixed an issue where a confirmation button in the tutorial could not be clicked after the last update.  

- Fixed a bug that could cause an error after moving in battle.  

- Fixed an issue where confirming without selecting a sub-attribute in skill contests would still consume action points.  

- Fixed an issue where dialogue could continue in the Chongwu Hall task even when action points were insufficient.  

- Fixed an issue where the quest tracker did not disappear after completing certain quests.

Improvements and Adjustments  

- Added effect descriptions to titles in the origin selection details screen.  

- Attempted to fix an issue where ranged NPCs were reluctant to attack from a distance.  

- Improved battlefield range indicators for better visibility.  

- Added realm display in the teammate interface to make it easier to see teammate strength.  

- Enhanced the character attribute panel to display internal power Yin-Yang attributes.


v1.0.5
Bug Fixes  

- Fixed an issue where buffs could not be viewed in the battlefield attribute panel.  

- Fixed a rare issue where dialogue could not continue after failing a stone talisman battle.

Improvements and Adjustments  

- Changed Shaolin Temple Bronze Man Alley to be repeatable for cultivation rewards.  

- Lowered the difficulty of the third battle for the Scholarly Family origin.  

- Adjusted the priority of Datong Mountain’s main and side quests so that the main quest takes precedence.  

- Increased the action point cap to 120.  

- Increased HP gains from leveling up for all origins.  

- Added a confirmation box when using rations in bulk.  

- Added a shop to the Ganzhou Chongwu Hall that sells basic weapons and martial arts manuals.

notes.title: 【Game Feature : Arts Duel(Card Play)】
notes.content:
There Is More Than Just Battles

In Wuxia Saga: Ten Thousand Paths, beyond the usual attack, defense attributes, there are also dozens of "Artistic Skills" such as music, chess, calligraphy, painting, and more. These skills not only influence martial arts but also play unique roles throughout the game—one of which is the Dueling Arts System introduced today.

Apart from martial duels, players can challenge others using different Artistic Skills. These duels allow players to enhance their skills, build relationships with characters, obtain special items, and even unlock hidden storylines.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44786950/34208881a0efdfb81dc019235c2198fe3c87df51.gif

Each duel is filled with strategy and unpredictability. The system is easy to learn but offers deep tactical possibilities. As you explore the world, you can collect various cards and craft unique strategies to outmatch your opponents!
